name: Pirate Captain
summary: A pirate leader who fights with rapier and pistol, charms foes, and ripostes melee attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.onHit: and the pirate has {ref:glossary/advantage} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.

bonusActions.name: Captain's Charm

save.targets: one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet

bonusActions.onFailure: The target has the {ref:condition/charmed} condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.

reactions.name: Riposte
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The pirate is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The pirate adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the pirate makes one Rapier attack against the triggering creature if within range.
